title: Agent Performance
subtitle: Which agents earn their keep — accept rate is the quality signal
loadErrorBody: Nothing is shown rather than zeros: an unknown number and a measured zero are different claims.

period.note: Runs are counted by when they ran, not by when someone triaged their findings.

costBasis.estimatedHint: Computed by DevDigest from token counts and a price table. Not reconciled against a provider invoice.
costBasis.mixedHint: Some runs are reconciled against billing, others are DevDigest estimates.

noCost: No cost recorded for this period.
excluded: {failed} failed and {noCost} with no recorded cost are excluded from cost and duration.

row.noDecisionsHint: No finding from this agent has been accepted or dismissed yet, so its accept rate is unknown — not zero.
row.smallSampleHint: Fewer than {n} decisions. Shown, but not ranked against well-sampled agents.
row.deletedHint: This agent no longer exists. Its runs are kept so the totals still explain the cost.

empty.title: No agent runs yet
empty.body: Nothing has run in this workspace. Run a review to populate this screen.

emptyPeriod.title: No runs in this period
emptyPeriod.body: There are runs in this workspace, but none inside the selected range. Widen the period.
